eps_bridge_lines: Items included in Adjusted EBITDA above
ngaap.notes: Vulcan's EBITDA bridge starts at net earnings (2021 Q3+: net earnings attributable to Vulcan) and adds back income tax, interest expense and the loss (earnings) on discontinued operations NET OF TAX before DDA&A, so published EBITDA is continuing-ops EBITDA; the schema check ni_vulcan+ebitda_bridge_tax+interest+total_dda=ebitda_pub therefore differs by ebitda_bridge_disc_ops (extra field, value as added); including it the check ties. adj_items.disc_ops is null (disc ops is not an EBITDA->Adjusted EBITDA item). Adjusted EPS bridge: 'Items included in Adjusted EBITDA above' is the after-tax per-share effect of all EBITDA adjustments. Business development = non-routine acquisition charges incl. purchase-accounting inventory step-up -> adj_items.acquisition; COVID-19 direct incremental costs -> adj_items.other. Q2-20: Business development was a net gain (-3.5) in the quarter. COVID-19 direct incremental costs 4.4. ROIC is TTM (14.2%).
